stem: Meera's teacher asks the class about the calendar printed beside the Gregorian dates on the school notice board. Which statement correctly describes the Indian National Calendar?

options.text: It is an official solar calendar used by the Government of India along with the Gregorian calendar.
It is a lunar calendar in which each month begins at full moon.
It is used only for festivals and has no official use in India.
It is a 354-day calendar that ignores the position of the Sun.

teacher.key_rationale: The Indian National Calendar is an official solar (365-day) calendar used by the Government of India alongside the Gregorian calendar, beginning on 22 March after the spring equinox. Options B and D wrongly describe a lunar calendar; option C wrongly denies its official status.
